goal: Make Merlin Studio execute an actual two-request local model/tool task on the approved OCI host while preserving all fixed authority and resource gates.

measured.scope: Real native model-acceptance entrypoint, not inference
measured.reason: No supported Python >=3.10 among the fixed enumerated candidate paths
measured.claim_boundary: Absence from enumerated paths does not establish system-wide absence.

measured.scope: Historical archive acquisition and static inspection
measured.root_cause: Publisher tar uses implicit parent directories; original validator assumed explicit directory entries.

measured.scope: Repaired static parser and native fixture checks, not interpreter deployment
measured.claim_boundary: Fixtures and offline archive replay do not install or execute the candidate interpreter.

measured.scope: Main GitLab research and Studio tests

hypotheses.claim: A reviewed ARM64 CPython 3.11 artifact can provide a separate versioned interpreter without altering system Python or provider
hypotheses.discriminating_test: native dependency inventory and independently approved fixed rollbackable installation/execution lane

hypotheses.claim: An already-existing compatible interpreter is present outside the fixed inventory
hypotheses.discriminating_test: bounded read-only path inventory with authorized candidate paths and per-path identity

hypotheses.claim: The existing provider/runtime can satisfy Studio tool tasks with a native Python 3.9 adapter
hypotheses.reason: would weaken Python3.10+ product contract and require independent compatibility tests, not a preflight bypass

defect_class: Incompatible runtime prerequisites and archive-layout assumptions; do not relabel missing evidence or failed checks as success.
decisions: Keep the real-model gate blocked and its original failure/evidence immutable.
Reuse current CACE 35-test implicit-parent repair; avoid overwriting stronger existing source with a duplicate.
Do not rerun the archived acquisition after historical failure; use retained hash-verified archive for readback.
Keep installation, privilege widening, model requests and state mutation separate from read-only static inspection.
Continue independent offline Studio/CI/source-cited research work while native interpreter qualification is pending.

acceptance_plan.action: Reconcile original archive identity, repaired namespace/ELF/license observations and current host interpreter inventory
acceptance_plan.gate: Exact source and native receipts reviewed, no installation or process execution inferred

acceptance_plan.action: Select an exact supported interpreter and installation destination with policy approval, privilege controls and rollback
acceptance_plan.gate: fresh host-native library/ABI compatibility, exact artifact and copyright/license approval, versioned isolated path

acceptance_plan.action: Install/activate only through separately approved native operation; preserve system Python and provider
acceptance_plan.gate: native Python3.10+ SSL/sqlite3, exit cleanup, no displaced executable, all protected service preflights

acceptance_plan.action: Run the fixed 2-request Merlin Studio real-model tool acceptance
acceptance_plan.gate: actual model+runtime weights/hashes, independent task reference, tracked 2 generation requests max, session and action evidence readback after restart

acceptance_plan.action: Review and promote only if original P00-P09 acceptance gates and independent release review are satisfied
acceptance_plan.gate: all required platform/host/model/security checks, no implied completion from narrowed smoke test

continuum.reason: no continuous approximation required for discrete interpreter compatibility
